capability: Manual reset of the team-competition stats and the month-rollover sequence reachable through the API: the reset re-reads the stub, rebases every user's initial stats, drops offset stats and retired-user stats, and re-parses to zero; stats accrued afterwards count from the new baseline; historic hourly rows survive; and the monthly-save-then-reset pair reproduces what the end-of-month scheduler does.
